A '''skirmish''' was fought on [[Pleem's Nexus]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] involving the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] against several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces in addition to other forces.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We've arrived.|Savage Opress upon arriving on Pleem's Nexus|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref>}}
Once [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and their [[Esano's sister|female captive]] left [[Orto Norwe]], they proceeded to [[Pleem's Nexus]] to meet with [[Esano]] so that they may get their reward for rescuing his sister, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were chasing them back on Orto Norwe were not far behind. Due to [[Bruu Jun-Fan]]'s [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometric]] ability, he learned that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were en route to Pleem's Nexus just by "reading" the headband that the female captive had left behind.

Meanwhile, on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had been recalled to aid in the hunt for the two Sith. Before he leaves, however, he speaks with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about not being able to attend the Senate War Rally that was to take place later on that day, by revealing to the Chancellor that he is to partake in the apprehension of Darth Maul and his brother. Unbeknownst to Skywalker though, Palpatine is the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious who trained Maul years before. Much to Palpatine's surprise that Maul is still alive, he wishes his friend to be careful in the apprehension.

Once Maul and Opress reached Pleem's Nexus, they landed at Esano's [[Unidentified castle (Pleem's Nexus)|palace]], with his sister requesting that he pays the Sith their reward for rescuing her, otherwise, they would kill her. Esano ignores this because with her [[Death/Legends|dead]], their family fortune would be his. Maul, infuriated with Esano, attacked him.

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|That's no way to treat a sibling. Much less a rather pathetic sister|Darth Maul to Esano in regards to the latter's sister|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters" />}}
[[File:No_way_to_treat_a_sibling.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Maul and Savage Opress slaughter Esano's guards.]]
Once Esano said that Maul and Opress should kill his sister, the two Sith started striking down Esano, his sister's pet [[kerko]], and his guards. The two rogues made short work of them, yet Esano's sister still remained alive. Maul told her that the palace was now hers, and in return, she gave them their reward, as promised. Moment's later, however, the Jedi strike team that had been pursuing them had made their way to Pleem's Nexus, and had landed at the palace.

[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], [[Ko Solok]], and three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] greeted the two Sith with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in hand. Plo Koon focused on Opress, while Jun-Fan and Solok focused on Maul, with the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] providing cover fire. Jun-Fan asked Maul about his former master, and claimed that if he told them his identity, that he would be brought to justice. As this was not part of Maul's plan, he did not tell them the identity of Darth Sidious.

During the battle, Jun-Fan destroyed the case that had the reward that belonged to Maul and Opress. At one point, Opress used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|push]] two of the clones off the landing platform, and deflect a blaster bolt at the other clone, and then pulled Plo Koon's [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] off of his face. Plo Koon, injured, could no longer fight in this battle and began to gasp for air. At another point, Maul [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|threw]] his lightsaber at Jun-Fan, but Jun-Fan dodged the weapon. Ko Solok was right behind him, however, and died in the process. Jun-Fan became enraged because of this action, and fought more aggressively. Jun-Fan began to choke Maul with his bare hands, but Maul used his [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanical]] legs to kick him off.

Just as Maul was about to finish off the Jedi Master, Anakin Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]] and injured Opress with the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Once they land, Maul and Opress leave in their stolen [[Starship/Legends|starship]], as Kenobi and Skywalker tend to Plo Koon and Bruu Jun-Fan.

==Aftermath==
After Darth Maul and Opress left the [[Pleem's Nexus system/Legends|Pleem's Nexus system]], Plo Koon got his breath mask back on, and began to breathe once more, and he rushed to the body of Bruu Jun-Fan and heard his final words before he became one with the Force. Skywalker, disappointed that the two brothers had escaped again, was then told by Esano's sister that they only escaped with the ship they had arrived in, and that they were missing their reward. Maul, wrought with revenge travels on with his injured brother into the unknown.
